# Advisers error codes (registry v1)

<!-- generated by scripts/check-contracts.mjs --update from packages/advisers/lib/error-codes.js; do not edit by hand -->

Baseline: 50 codes frozen from committed 0.2.4 source at git `35a51c3` (package 0.2.4), frozen 2026-11-20.
Plus 82 0.3.0 + 56 0.4.0 additive codes extracted from the modules landing in those releases (provisional until their modules are committed).

The registry is the single source of truth: CLI, MCP and library error handling must use codes listed here,
and a new `E_*` literal in tracked source fails `node scripts/check-contracts.mjs --errors` until it is registered.
Codes are additive: never rename or change the meaning of an existing code.

Exit codes: 188 CLI codes and 5 DSH external codes.

| Exit | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 1 | user/config/runtime error (the default for registered codes) |
| 3 | TOS consent required (`E_TOS_REQUIRED`) |

Exit 4/5/6 are reserved by `contracts/cli/exit-codes-v2.draft.json` and are **not active**; scripts must read `error.code`.

## DSH adapter external codes (kept verbatim)

These are part of the DSH tool contract, not `E_*` codes; they are preserved additively.

| Code | Category | Surfaces | Stable | Remedy | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | usage | dsh | yes | Pass every required argument with the documented type; see the tool description in the DSH bundle. | `packages/dsh-advisers/index.js` |
| `UNKNOWN_ID_PREFIX` | usage | dsh | yes | Ids must start with cm_ (commitment), fact_ (fact) or pref_ (preference). | `packages/dsh-advisers/index.js` |
| `EVIDENCE_NOT_FOUND` | evidence | dsh | yes | No record matched in the preview ledger. Use the CLI (`advisers evidence show <id> --json`) for real-ledger evidence in 0.3.0. | `packages/dsh-advisers/index.js` |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | internal | dsh | yes | Unexpected adapter failure; retry once and report the message without customer data. | `packages/dsh-advisers/index.js` |
| `CONTENT_BLOCKED` | content | dsh | yes | The local content-safety layer blocked the call. Do not retry the same content; review it first. | `packages/dsh-advisers/index.js` |

## Adding a code

1. Add the entry to `packages/advisers/lib/error-codes.js` (category, exit 1 or 3, surfaces, since, stable, remedy, optional doc).
2. Run `node scripts/check-contracts.mjs --update` to regenerate this file and `contracts/errors/codes.v1.json`.
3. Run `node scripts/check-contracts.mjs --errors`; every tracked source literal must be registered and every registered code must still exist.

```sh
node scripts/check-contracts.mjs --errors --update
node scripts/check-contracts.mjs
```
